en: 1 Chronicles 12

zh: 早期跟隨大衛的便雅憫人

p.src: 1  Now these are those who came to David to Ziklag while he was a fugitive from Saul the son of Kish. They were among the mighty men, his helpers in war.

ja: していたころ、ツィクラグで
のもとに加わった者たちは次のとおりである。彼らは戦いで彼を助けた勇士たちの中にいた。

p.src: 2  They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in slinging stones and in shooting arrows from the bow. They were of Saul’s relatives of the tribe of Benjamin.

p.src: 17  David went out to meet them, and answered them, “If you have come peaceably to me to help me, my heart will be united with you; but if you have come to betray me to my adversaries, since there is no wrong in my hands, may the God of our fathers see this and rebuke it.”

ja: った。「もしあなたがたが、私を
けるために平和な思いで私のもとに
つに結ばれる。しかし、私の
法なことがないのに、あなたがたが私を
て、お叱りになるように。」
en: David went out to meet them, and answered them, “If you have come peaceably to me to help me, my heart will be united with you; but if you have come to betray me to my adversaries, since there is no wrong in my hands, may the God of our fathers see this and rebuke it.”

p.src: 18  Then the Spirit came on Amasai, who was chief of the thirty, and he said, “We are yours, David, and on your side, you son of Jesse. Peace, peace be to you, and peace be to your helpers; for your God helps you.” Then David received them and made them captains of the band.

ja: の長であるアマサイに霊が
った。 「ダビデよ、私たちはあなたのもの。 エッサイの
よ、私たちはあなたとともにいる。
あれ、平安あれ、あなたに。 あなたを
けておられる。」 そこでダビデは
en: Then the Spirit came on Amasai, who was chief of the thirty, and he said, “We are yours, David, and on your side, you son of Jesse. Peace, peace be to you, and peace be to your helpers; for your God helps you.” Then David received them and made them captains of the band.

p.src: 19  Some of Manasseh also joined David when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle, but they didn’t help them, for the lords of the Philistines sent him away after consultation, saying, “He will desert to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.”

ったときである。しかし
って、彼を送り去ったからである。
